mapper.select: select t.id, t.name, coalesce(c.cnt, 0) as `count` from tag t left join ( select at.tag_id as tag_id, count(distinct a.id) as cnt from article_tag at inner join article a on a.id = at.article_id inner join article_config ac on ac.article_id = a.id and ac.is_draft = 0 and ac.is_del = 0 and coalesce(ac.status, 1) != 3 group by at.tag_id ) c on c.tag_id = t.id order by `count` desc
